name: Fyle
summary: Fyle charges $11.99 an active user each month on Growth with a 5-user minimum, or $14.99 on Business with a 10-user minimum, both billed annually. Multi-stage approvals and US ACH reimbursement start on Business.

facts.text: Growth checks policy violations in real time but allows single-stage approvals only.
ACH reimbursements are listed on Business and are US only.
An active user creates at least one expense or has a corporate card with one transaction in the month.
Fyle says it became SOC 2 Type II compliant on August 18, 2022, after reaching Type I in January 2022.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Billed annually with a 5-user minimum; no monthly price is shown

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing for organizations with 250 or more employees

hiddenCosts: Two-way accounting integrations carry a one-time implementation fee.
SSO and premium support are optional add-ons with extra fees.
The QuickBooks Desktop integration costs extra.
